title: Reporting & Analytics - Quiz
description: Test your understanding of reporting and analytics concepts in PEGA

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of reporting in PEGA applications?
options: To provide insights and support data-driven decision making
questions.explanation: Reporting provides insights and supports data-driven decision making by transforming raw data into meaningful information for business users and stakeholders.

questions.question: When should you use summary views vs list views?
options: Summary views for aggregated data, list views for detailed records
questions.explanation: Summary views are used for aggregated data and metrics, while list views display detailed records - choosing the appropriate type based on user needs.

questions.question: How do you optimize report performance?
options: Through selective columns, proper filtering, and indexing
questions.explanation: Report performance is optimized through selective column selection, proper filtering criteria, appropriate indexing, and efficient query design.

questions.question: What is the benefit of real-time dashboards?
options: They provide immediate insights and current status visibility
questions.explanation: Real-time dashboards provide immediate insights and current status visibility, enabling users to make timely decisions based on up-to-date information.

questions.question: When should you implement drill-down reports?
options: When users need to explore detailed data from summary views
questions.explanation: Drill-down reports should be implemented when users need to explore detailed data from summary views, providing hierarchical navigation from high-level metrics to underlying details.

questions.question: How do you ensure report security?
options: Through access control policies and data filtering based on user roles
questions.explanation: Report security is ensured through access control policies and data filtering based on user roles, ensuring users only see data appropriate to their permissions.

questions.question: What is crucial for data accuracy in reports?
options: Comprehensive data validation, cleansing, and source verification
questions.explanation: Data accuracy in reports requires comprehensive data validation, cleansing processes, source verification, and regular quality checks to ensure reliability.

questions.question: How should you handle large dataset reporting?
options: Through pagination, aggregation, and incremental loading strategies
questions.explanation: Large dataset reporting should use pagination, aggregation techniques, incremental loading strategies, and efficient query design to maintain performance and usability.
